patterns: Are you a robot or a human?
responses: I am CampusBot, a virtual assistant built to answer college-related questions.
My name is CampusBot. I was built using Python and Natural Language Processing.
You can call me CampusBot. I am an automated assistant, not a human, but I am here to help!

patterns: Give me information about the college
What is this college known for?
responses: Our college offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in engineering and technology, with a strong focus on practical learning, research and industry exposure. For the exact address and establishment details, please check the official college website or admissions office.
The college provides modern laboratories, experienced faculty, placement training and active student clubs. You can ask me specifically about courses, fees, library, hostel or placements.
It is an institution focused on academics, innovation and placements. Tell me which aspect you want to know about - courses, fees, facilities or placements - and I will share what I can.

patterns: List the courses offered by the college
Is Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning available?
What programs can I study here?
responses: The college offers B.Tech programs including Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, Electronics and Communication, Electrical, Mechanical and Civil Engineering, along with postgraduate programs. Please confirm the current year's list with the admissions office.
Popular programs include CSE, AI and ML, Data Science and ECE. Ask the admissions office for the full, up-to-date list of branches and seats.
Courses span engineering branches such as CSE, AIML, ECE, EEE, Mechanical and Civil. Which branch are you interested in?

patterns: How are the placements in this college?
Will I get a job after this course?
responses: The college has a dedicated placement cell that conducts aptitude, coding and soft-skills training, mock interviews and drives with IT and core companies. For the latest placement statistics and package figures, please check the official placement report.

Placement training usually starts well before the final year and covers DSA, aptitude, communication skills and interviews. I cannot promise a job or quote a package - those depend on the year, the company and your preparation.
Companies from IT services, software and related sectors visit campus drives. Ask the placement office for this year's company list and results.

patterns: How much are the college fees?
What is the tuition fee per year?
How much do I have to pay for admission?
Is there an installment option for fees?
responses: Fees vary by course, admission category and academic year, so I do not quote exact amounts here. Please contact the admissions or accounts office for the official fee structure for your course and year.
For accurate fee, scholarship and installment details, the college office is the right source - they can give you the current figures in writing.
Scholarships and fee concessions may be available based on merit and government schemes. Please verify your eligibility with the admissions office.

patterns: How many books can I borrow?
Does the college have a library?
Can I access e-books and journals?
responses: The college library has textbooks, reference books, journals and a digital section for e-resources. Timings and borrowing limits can change, so please check the notice board or the librarian for the current rules.
You can borrow books using your library card and access digital resources on campus systems. Ask the library staff for the current timings and issue limit.
The library is a good place for quiet study and project work. Please confirm opening hours with the library desk, as they differ on exam days and holidays.

patterns: Do you have separate hostels for boys and girls?
Can I stay in a hostel?
responses: Hostel accommodation is generally available for outstation students, usually with separate blocks, mess food, water and security. For current availability, room types and fees, please contact the hostel office.
Please check with the college administration for hostel admission, fees and rules, as allotment is subject to availability.
Hostels typically provide sharing rooms, a mess and common facilities. I recommend visiting the hostel once, if possible, before deciding.
You are welcome! Happy to help.
Anytime! Let me know if you have more questions.
Glad I could help. All the best!
